SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I recognized you the moment you walked in.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 你一进来我就看出来了！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你一進來我就認出你了！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 俺はお前、入ってきた瞬間にすぐ分かったぞ
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku langsung ngeh pas kamu masuk, lho.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Te reconheci no momento em que você entrou.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: من تا پاتو گذاشتی تو سریع فهمیدم کی هستی!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Of course~ You changed your hair!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 当然啦～你换发色了不是吗？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 当たり前だろ〜髪変わってたじゃん！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ya iyalah~ Kamu kan ganti gaya rambut!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 그래~ 전엔 좀 갈색 느낌이었던 거 같은데?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Yeah, it used to look kind of brown, didn’t it?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 对啊~之前好像是带点棕色的感觉？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 我記得你以前有點咖啡色的感覺欸？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: そうそう〜前はちょっと茶色っぽかった気がするけど？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Iya~ Dulu kayaknya agak coklat deh?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Sim, antes parecia meio castanho, não era?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡Sí~! Antes como que tenías un tono más castaño, ¿no?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آره دیگه~ قبلاً یه ته رنگ قهوه‌ای نداشت مگه؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I’ve had black hair my whole life.
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 私、生まれてからずっと黒髪だよ？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kayaknya dari lahir rambutku selalu warna hitam deh.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Eu tive cabelo preto a vida toda.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: He tenido el cabello negro toda mi vida.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: من از روزی که به دنیا اومدم موهام پرکلاغی مشکی بوده!

SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ちょっとぐらいとかもなかった…？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Beneran nggak ada coklat-coklatnya... sama sekali...?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: حتی یه ذره هم قهوه‌ای نبوده یعنی...؟
